content.short: FastLane builds shMONAD, a liquid staking token on Monad backed by staking rewards and MEV.
content.description: FastLane issues shMON, a liquid staking token for Monad backed by both staking rewards and MEV revenue from its own protocol. Validators running the FastLane sidecar route their order flow through it, and adoption covers 114 of Monad's 196 validators by the project's count. Holders earn from four separate yield streams, with base staking issuance as the floor under them. An institutional staking route sits alongside the public one, with live APY drawn from its sidecar API and DefiLlama.
